inputMethod: Caller-provided queued synthetic controller poses and grip states, through production Input Actions and saved XRDirectInteractor/XRRayInteractor. No SelectEnter, SelectExit, activated.Invoke or reflected lifecycle calls.
languageMethod: Public LanguageChannel.SetLanguage API; this module does not claim to test the language buttons.
fixtureMethods: Public ResetTour/ResetInspection/SetWindowOpen preconditions and cleanup, ReturnInspectionToDisplay for the smooth-return API regression, ReduceMotion=false for that fixture, component/GameObject disable-enable, and saved SerializedObject field reads. Helmet displacement/rotation and subsequent hotspot selection use production controller input. No asset writes or generator calls.
limitations: Automated poses are not physical controller/headset testing. PNGs are diagnostic monocular panel close-ups, not the visitor camera or readability/user-study evidence.
